clue.text: Take advantage of the people present

parts.note: to do someone is to cheat or take advantage of them
a nation is a whole people

explanation.surface: An instruction to exploit whoever happens to be in the room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'present' looks like an adjective meaning 'here', but it is the noun, a gift.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift handed over to a cause is a present given freely.

clue.text: A person well able to deal with any ill-feeling!

definitions.text: A person well able to deal with any ill-feeling!

parts.words: A person well able to deal with any ill-feeling!
parts.note: ill-feeling reads as resentment, but here it is literally feeling ill, which a medical practitioner treats

explanation.definitionFit: A physician is the person whose job is curing those who feel unwell.

clue.text: Prior occupying quarters in a French town

indicators.note: one piece occupies, that is sits inside, the other

parts.note: N and S are two compass quarters, north and south
ante is Latin for before, as in ante-room

explanation.surface: A monastery's senior monk lodging in rooms in a French town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prior' looks like a monk but is the adjective 'earlier', giving ANTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Nantes is a city on the Loire in western France.

clue.text: A crack about the aim to be in vogue

indicators.note: one piece goes about, or round, the other

parts.note: to have a crack at something is to have a try
an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: Making an attempt at being fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Something trendy is fashionable, currently in style.

clue.text: Workplace rivals?

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a musical work
a position is a place

explanation.surface: Competitors in the same office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Workplace' splits into 'Work' and 'place'; the question mark flags that split.
explanation.definitionFit: The opposition are the rival side one competes against.

clue.text: Face parking in a school enclosure

indicators.note: one piece is put in the other

parts.note: a school of thought is a sect
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: A school's walled enclosure with parking space facing it.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspect is one face or side of something, such as a building's frontage.

clue.text: The main way to travel cheaply

definitions.text: The main way to travel cheaply

parts.words: The main way to travel cheaply
parts.note: 'the main' is the open sea, and the cheapest way to cross it by ship was in the lowest passenger class

explanation.definitionFit: Steerage was the cheapest class of accommodation on a passenger ship.

clue.text: Judge set a mite wrong

indicators.note: the words are put wrong, that is jumbled into another order

explanation.surface: A judge has put a small coin or insect in the wrong place.
explanation.definitionFit: To judge a figure roughly is to estimate it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Pressing a point in traffic

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other

parts.note: to traffic is to deal or trade
E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Emphasising a point while stuck in traffic.
explanation.definitionFit: Treading grapes is pressing them underfoot.

clue.text: Scorn but study allure

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn
to allure is to tempt

explanation.surface: A remark that someone despises learning yet finds it attractive.
explanation.definitionFit: Contempt is the disdain or derision that scorn expresses.

clue.text: Scan an article and get all steamed up

parts.note: to scan something is to look at it, see it
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Reading a newspaper piece and getting furious.
explanation.definitionFit: To seethe is to boil with anger, the figurative sense of being steamed up.

clue.text: Take too much dope and do ever so badly

indicators.note: the words are treated badly, that is put in a scrambled order

explanation.surface: Warning that drug excess will make you fare terribly.
explanation.definitionFit: To overdose is to take an excessive amount of a drug.

clue.text: Scoffed about buffet put together

indicators.note: one piece goes about the other

parts.note: scoffed means ate greedily, fed
to buffet is to strike, ram

explanation.surface: Someone ate greedily around the buffet table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'buffet' looks like a spread of food, which 'Scoffed' supports; it is the verb meaning strike.
explanation.definitionFit: Something framed is constructed, its parts put together.

clue.text: He's expected to step out with due regard for the dog

parts.note: pace, from Latin, means with all respect to someone
a setter is a breed of gun dog

explanation.surface: A man who walks the dog with proper care.
explanation.walkthrough: PACE (pronounced PAH-chay) is the Latin 'with respect to', as in 'pace the critics'.
explanation.definitionFit: A pacesetter leads the way, the one who steps out in front for others to follow.

clue.text: Tear things out and arrange properly

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: Rip things out and tidy them up.
explanation.definitionFit: To straighten is to put in order, tidy.

clue.text: A woman with child must receive cash, that's clear

indicators.note: the outer piece takes in, receives, the other

parts.note: a woman with a child is a parent
P, penny, stands for a small sum of cash

explanation.surface: A mother must get money, that's obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: Something apparent is plainly visible, clear.

clue.text: Care isn't exercised in this case

indicators.note: exercised suggests the letters are worked about into a new order

explanation.surface: A claim that no care is taken in this legal case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case' reads as a legal matter, but is a container.
explanation.definitionFit: A canister is a small container, a case for tea or film.

clue.text: They'll close talks after a request for silence

indicators.note: the talking piece comes after the request for quiet

parts.note: sh is the hushing sound asking for quiet
to utter is to speak, so talks means utters

explanation.surface: Discussions resume once someone has called for quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: Shutters close over windows, so they are things that will close.

clue.text: Missile launcher remains overturned — look around

indicators.note: the looking piece goes around the rest

parts.note: to peer is to look closely
ash is what remains after burning

indicators.note: turned, joined to over, means the over piece is read backwards

parts.note: over in the sense of excessively, as in over-eager, means too

explanation.surface: A rocket launcher has been knocked over; glance about for it.
explanation.walkthrough: The single word 'overturned' does two jobs: its front half 'over' is a piece meaning excessively, and 'turned' is the reversal signal for that piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A peashooter is a tube for blowing dried peas, a toy launcher of missiles.

clue.text: Approached a queen, being in dire straits

indicators.note: one piece is in the other

parts.note: to be in dire straits is to be in need
R, for Regina, is the abbreviation for a queen

explanation.surface: A queen came near while in desperate trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Neared means came close to, approached.

clue.text: The vicious man is put down first

parts.note: put down means depressed, sad
1st, written IST, is first

explanation.surface: The cruel man is to be put to death first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put down' suggests killing an animal; here it means dejected.
explanation.definitionFit: A sadist is a person who takes pleasure in cruelty.

clue.text: The result of joint business action

definitions.text: The result of joint business action

parts.words: The result of joint business action
parts.note: two companies acting jointly to combine into one

explanation.definitionFit: Firms joining together form a single combined company.

clue.text: Reading a note about the Roman way to fly

indicators.note: the note pieces go about the way

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
via is Latin for road or way

explanation.surface: Interpreting a memo about the Roman way to fly.
explanation.definitionFit: To aviate is to fly an aircraft.

clue.text: Left always with time to complete purchase

parts.note: ever means always
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Departed for good with time to finish buying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'purchase' means grip or mechanical advantage, not buying.
explanation.definitionFit: Leverage is mechanical purchase, the grip or advantage a lever gives.

clue.text: Course in a setting of evergreen trees

indicators.note: the answer is set within the letters of these words

explanation.surface: A golf course framed by evergreen trees.
explanation.definitionFit: An entree is a course of a meal.

clue.text: A sailing man in some irritation getting under way

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other

parts.note: a sting is a sharp irritation
a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor somewhat annoyed as his voyage begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Starting means beginning, getting going.

clue.text: Beat the endless spottiness!

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a rash is an outbreak of spots

explanation.surface: Getting the better of acne with no end in sight.
explanation.definitionFit: To thrash is to beat soundly.

clue.text: Director harassed by an individual who's owed money

indicators.note: harassed suggests the letters are put into disorder

explanation.surface: A company director hounded by someone he owes.
explanation.definitionFit: A creditor is someone to whom a debt is due.
